triggers.name: business_creative_receipt_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER business_creative_receipt_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON zoi.business_creative_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION zoi.business_creative_receipt_immutable()

triggers.name: studio_media_receipt_context
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER studio_media_receipt_context BEFORE INSERT ON zoi.business_creative_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION zoi.studio_media_receipt_guard()

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.business_creative_source(p_entity jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_entity)='object'THEN jsonb_build_object('schema',1)||zoi.business_creative_project_layer(p_entity,'top')ELSE NULL END
$function$

constraints.name: business_creative_requests_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state = 'saved'::text) AND (payload IS NOT NULL) AND (post_id IS NOT NULL) AND (post_snapshot IS NOT NULL)) OR ((state = 'cancelled'::text) AND (payload IS NULL) AND (post_id IS NULL) AND (post_snapshot IS NULL))))
